messages:
tara: Quick sync — vendor roadmap slotting for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Need to lock marketplace announce windows and fallback play for surge. Who's free for a short thread? :wave:

kevin: I'm in. What's the hard constraint? latency SLO for hosted API during surge?

tara: Target SLO is p95 < 250ms for short sequences. For launches we can accept brief 500ms spikes if fallback works. Primary ask: reserve 20% dedicated capacity for first 2 weeks of GA, and define fallback routing to other model families.

maria: Ops note — we can reserve GPU pools in Dedicated but marketplace images need to be staged. Can we push canary images earlier? Suggest image tags: `gaudi-v1-canary`, `mi300-quant-canary`.

alex: Vendor update from NVIDIA: H100 initial shipments will land week-of 2025-06-09 (ETA). H200 still TBD — vendor asks for a 2-week embargo on press. Gaudi timing looks stable per Habana: next batch ships mid-May.

sophie: For joint announcement with SI partners, we need at least 72-hour embargo window for documentation and partner approvals. Also confirm kernel and firmware: kernel 6.1.x + nv-firmware 2024-04 required for H100 perf knobs.

kevin: Fallback plan proposal: route preference H100 -> H200 -> MI300 -> Gaudi -> quantized CPU fallback. Also add routing policy by region: us-west -> H100, eu -> MI300 primary.

tara: Sounds good. Action items: (1) Alex confirm H100 exact delivery date and press embargo window. (2) Maria stage canary images and share tags. (3) Kevin prepare routing policy PR and simulated load test. (4) Sophie draft SI announcement checklist. I'll schedule 30m sync if any blockers.

alex: Confirming H100 tentative ETA 2025-06-09; vendor embargo request: 2025-06-16 release wait for joint comms. They'll confirm final ETA tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maria: Started staging canaries: images pushed to registry under `redwood/gaudi:v1-canary` and `redwood/mi300:quant-canary`. Perf tests queued.

kevin: I opened PR #482 to add routing policy, includes continuous fallback and scoring by latency/cost. Local sim shows <300ms p95 for 1k qps with 20% reserve. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/policy/pulls/482

sophie: Drafted SI checklist and shared in docs: /docs/partners/si-onboard-hw-announce.md. Key items: partner approvals, embargo handshake, SSO config, runbooks.

tara: Ok — will sync after Alex confirms embargo. If embargo is strict, we'll align press window with SI and marketplace cutover and keep dedicated reserve. Thanks all. :rocket:

nvidia_pm: FYI from vendor: H200 firmware release slipped by 1 week, we'll update API and ETA later. Apologies.

kevin: Noted. That affects fallback ordering but PR already supports skipping missing variants.

tara: Great — closing thread unless someone needs more. :white_check_mark:
